- Modules: Core (Base Block), Kvant-1, Kvant-2, Kristall, Spektr, Priroda, plus a docking module (from Space Shuttle program).
- Solar arrays: large solar panels on modules.

- Mir deorbited in 2001, burned up in atmosphere.
